about: Firm-wide conventions used when a source is silent. Values used from here are tagged src=convention by the pipelines and listed in their reports. A project picks a set (project.json → standards); a set may 'extends' another and override keys. NOT authority rules — those are in library/Rules/.
units: metres unless the key says otherwise

frames.world: X east, Y north, Z up; metres
frames.asset: built at the origin, Z up, front toward -Y
frames._src: interior AGENTS.md §2, exterior AGENTS.md §2, tracer core/model.py

ground_levels._rule: strictly ordered terrain < road < yard < kerb = plot < paving so no two surfaces z-fight

objects._src: program_pipeline standards (DEFAULT empty; values = typology defaults)

fixture_backs._about: canvas-library rotation tables — backs MEASURED from baked footprints at rotation 0 (Floorplan Improver bake table). Only measured kinds belong here; others export with their raw rotation.
fixture_backs._src: canvas library rotation tables — measured backs (Floorplan Improver bake table); used by every canvas reader/writer

symbol_legend._source: Floorplan Tracer skill — Indian developer brochure plans
symbol_legend.box with a dashed X: duct / service shaft (a SPACE, not furniture)
symbol_legend.quarter arc + leaf line: hinged door (hinge = arc centre, swing = arc side)
symbol_legend.small squares at junctions (sketch): columns — count the grid lines, not the squares

mesh_quality.uv1: Smart UV lightmap, one 0–1 square per mesh
